author: FunForLouis
description:
I’ve had so much fun testing out Beni over the last few days 🤖 Such a unique way to capture moments and honestly way more personality than I expected!

Huge thanks to @mondorobotics for letting us take Beni on some adventures. If you want to check it out, it’s launching on Kickstarter now, with early backers able to lock in the launch discount.
title: My Robot That Vlogs For Me!
